comparison.faces: Compared Hariyama, Azurill, Nosepass, Skitty and Delcatty face crops. Skitty has compact rounded cheeks, small narrow brown eyes and a rounder nose; Delcatty has longer oval proportions, more open purple eyes and a slender bridge. Recent three have a stronger jaw, rounder large eyes, and an angular longer face respectively.
comparison.casuals: Compared actual recent Hariyama, Azurill and Nosepass casual images plus both new three-image sets. Skitty: overhead cap removal at a lap pool, toe-led studio dance in leotard/wrap skirt, forward kitchen mold work in blouse/mini. Delcatty: basket carrying in embroidered blouse/slit skirt at craft fair, ribbon selection in structured plum corset, charm inspection in halter romper at lantern booth. Location, task, clothing construction and arm/torso gesture vary; the trio does not repeat recent analyzer/arcade/linen-folding or gemstone/water-step/racer trio.
